title: Confidence rejection blocks replayed minimum-margin perturbations

invariants.description: PGD L∞ ε=0.3 must still evade the undefended model.
Replayed perturbations that barely cross the boundary must be rejected, not misclassified.
The rejection threshold must not abstain on more than 20% of clean test inputs.

Most replayed perturbations are blocked by ABSTAINING (not by being classified correctly). Abstentions must be reported as abstentions: they are neither attack successes nor correct predictions, so adversarial_accuracy must not count them.

rationale: Early-stopped PGD lands just past the boundary, where model confidence is low. See MLB-REG-004 for why this result alone is misleading.
